sections.paragraph: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited, an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company, was established in 1981 by Satish Mehta with a bank loan of ₹3 lakh. The company initially began as a contract manufacturing organization but transitioned to producing generic drugs in the 1990s. Over the years, Emcure has expanded its product portfolio to include tablets, capsules, injectables, and various therapeutic drugs. Recently, the company reported a 23% revenue increase in the first quarter, with Ebitda growing 25.8% and net profit rising 36.2%. Emcure has also completed the acquisition of a minority stake in Gennova Biopharmaceuticals and is focusing on its five-year plan, with the current year being about delivery and growth. The company's board of directors is scheduled to meet to consider and approve its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
